maybe_fsdp_wrap: use the maybe_fsdp_wrap context manager to enable FullyShardedDataParallel wrapping with mixed precision and auto wrap policy
get_state_dict: get the full state dict from an FSDP model with CPU offloading for saving checkpoints
is_fsdp: check whether a PyTorch module is wrapped in FullyShardedDataParallel
